_meta.purpose: OBS Studio recording profile for the Phase-8 demo recordings (Track 2 v2 + Track 3 MCP).
_meta.authority: implements gcp-research/decisions/DECISIONS.md D30 (8x speed real-mouse-action recording) and gcp-research/demo/SCRIPT.md §2.1.
_meta.rationale: 1920x1080 @ 60 fps source becomes 480 fps effective after 8x speed warp, which keeps motion smooth. CRF 18 + x264 veryfast preset gives a lossless-quality intermediate at a recordable bitrate. MKV container is recoverable if OBS crashes mid-record; final MP4 container is produced by the post-process chain, not the recorder.
_meta.tested_obs_version: OBS Studio 30.x (macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64)

Mic1.name: Microphone
Mic1._note: operator must verify -12 dBFS peak via the obs audio mixer before pressing record

websocket._password_note: stored in macOS Keychain under service=obs-studio account=websocket; scripts read OBS_WEBSOCKET_PASSWORD from env

_install_note: Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/basic/profiles/social-seeding-v2-demo/basic.ini (macOS) or ~/.config/obs-studio/basic/profiles/social-seeding-v2-demo/basic.ini (Linux), then in OBS Studio choose Profile > social-seeding-v2-demo from the Profile menu. obs-studio reads ini, not json, so the host adapter scripts/demo/obs/profile.json -> basic.ini converter in start-recording.sh handles the translation.
_validation_checklist: Output > Recording > Recording Format = mkv (NOT mp4 — MKV is recoverable on crash)
Output > Recording > Encoder = x264 (NOT hardware NVENC/QuickSync — quality > speed for the intermediate)
Output > Recording > Rate Control = CRF, CRF = 18
Audio > Mic peaks at -12 dBFS during a 30 s narration test
